name: finmesh-evidence
purpose: The minimised evidence record a member discloses about one of its account-windows (S2; S3 releases each field through k-ary randomised response; S1 discloses only the alert flag and time bucket).
token: OPRF token of the account under the epoch key (finmesh.matching.tokens), 16 bytes
time: window index of the account-window (6 h bucket); a response carries the most recent record in the requested range

probability.source: member's own score, isotonic-calibrated on data earlier than the run (held-out training windows for validation runs; validation for the test run)

deviations.source: the member's local autoencoder: per-feature squared reconstruction error of the robust-scaled features (finmesh.models.autoencoder)
deviations.direction: +1 when the feature is above its reconstruction, -1 below

missing: a missing value takes the bucket after the last regular one (len(edges) + 1)
